superPowers.name: Web Line
superPowers.body: Push an enemy character within |!range| 4 Toward this character |!range_small|. A character can be Pushed by this superpower only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Web-a-pult
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature or an enemy character, both of |!size| 2 or less and within |!range| 3, and Throw it |!range_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Spider-Sense
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against an |!physical| or |!energy| attack or making a dodge roll, it may reroll up to 2 of its defense or dodge dice.
